sig: [[["A", "Right, thanks everyone for joining. I'll keep this short and summarise what came out of yesterday's sprint retrospective."], ["A", "First, the good news: we delivered eleven of the twelve stories we committed to, which is our best result this quarter."], ["A", "The one we didn't finish, the payment export feature, has been carried over to the next sprint."], ["A", "On the downside, a lot of you mentioned that code reviews were taking too long."], ["A", "Some pull requests sat for three days before anyone looked at them."], ["A", "So going forward, we're trying a new rule: every pull request should get a first review within one working day."], ["A", "Tomas has kindly agreed to set up a Slack reminder that pings reviewers automatically."], ["A", "Another point was that our stand-ups were regularly running over fifteen minutes."], ["A", "Well, I've timed myself, and I'm not innocent either."], ["A", "From Monday, we'll move any detailed discussion to a separate thread after the stand-up."], ["A", "Finally, please add your estimates for the new backlog items by end of day Thursday, so we can plan properly on Friday morning."], ["A", "Any questions, just give me a shout."]], {"A": "M-GB"}]
